# A bomb arrow costs no bomb, and the bomb key only readies one at full draw; an arrow falls at 0.6 a step,

# He picks up the Bow (255) and draws it (267). He presses the bomb key at strength 2.2 (277): its line sets
# holdArrow = ARROW_BOMB, but the draw's, later in the same step, sets ARROW_NORM on every step it draws
# (bowStrength < 12), so it stays a plain arrow. He lets it go (282): oArrow's create sets myGrav = 0.2, but
# oItem's step sets it back to 0.6 on every step the item isn't in lava, after that step's gravity, so its
# yVel goes 0.2, 0.8, 1.4, 2 (282-285) before it lands. He draws again (301), to full strength (360, 60 steps
# of 0.2), and presses the bomb key (366): with no draw step after it, holdArrow stays ARROW_BOMB. He shoots
# it (376), and it sticks in the wall's foot; nothing has taken a bomb. Its counter, which ran from 366 in his
# hands, ends 80 steps on (446): it explodes there, breaking the wall's bricks, while bombs stays 4.
